An established colony with long-serving tanks

Palam Vihar is a well-settled residential colony of independent houses and builder floors. Many homes have been lived in for years, and some have added floors over time. As a result, tank setups vary: one house may have a single rooftop tank and its own sump, while the house next door has a tank for every floor, added one by one as the building grew.

Plenty of these tanks have been in service for a long time. Years of sun can make plastic tanks faded and more brittle, lids can stop fitting well, and an old sump can collect a thick layer of sludge if it has been skipped in past cleanings.

Why tanks here get dirty

Fine silt in supply water settles into sludge at the bottom of every tank. A rooftop tank that sits in full sun from April to June grows algae on the walls and under the lid. A lid that no longer seals lets in dust, leaves and insects. Where a home tops up from a tanker or borewell, sediment tends to build up faster, mostly in the sump.

Why no-entry cleaning suits older tanks

The traditional way is to send a worker inside the tank. On an older plastic tank, a person standing on a thin, sun-worn floor can crack it. We clean from outside instead: a sludge pump pulls out silt, a high-pressure jet washes the walls, floor and lid through the opening, then a food-safe disinfectant, a clean-water flush and drying. Each tank takes about 60 to 90 minutes. If we notice a crack or a damaged lid, you will see it in the before and after photos we send on WhatsApp. We don't do tank repairs, but you will know what needs attention.

  • Rooftop plastic tanks, one or several per house
  • Underground concrete sumps, cleaned from the manhole so nobody goes down
  • Groups of neighbours or buildings with 5 or more tanks, at bulk rates

How to book

Send your tank details from the quote form or a photo on WhatsApp. If you know roughly how old the tank is, or the roof has no lift and several flights of stairs, mention it. We reply with a free fixed quote, including GST, before the visit. Pick a slot, and pay after the job by UPI or cash. No advance.

Nearby areas: we also clean tanks along the Dwarka Expressway sectors and in Old Gurgaon.

Questions

Our rooftop tank is old and faded. Is it safe to clean?

Yes. Nobody stands inside it, so the floor takes no weight. If we see a crack, we show you in the photos.

Our house has two rooftop tanks and a sump. Can you do all three in one visit?

Yes. Each tank takes about 60 to 90 minutes. Send all three in your request and we give one fixed quote.

Can we join with neighbours to book together?

Yes. If the group has 5 or more tanks in total, bulk rates apply. Share the list of tanks on WhatsApp.
